up: List the ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES of compounds tested against the human CB1 receptor (CHEMBL218) in human assays. Only return rows for compounds that have a canonical SMILES available.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.tid = (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL218') AND a.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
